sources.name: IEEE Atlanta Section (vTools)
sources.note: Get the section's public iCal feed URL from events.vtools.ieee.org (Events → Export/iCal for the Atlanta Section), paste it into 'url', then set enabled:true.

sources.name: Atlanta AI Meetup groups (Meetup.com)
sources.note: Any Meetup group exposes an iCal feed at https://www.meetup.com/<group-slug>/events/ical/ — add one source entry per local AI group and set enabled:true.

sources.name: Georgia Tech / university calendars
sources.note: Most university event calendars (Localist, Google Calendar) publish an ICS feed — paste it here. AI keyword filtering is applied automatically.

sources.name: Eventbrite (requires free API token)
sources.note: Eventbrite retired public event search; per-organizer listings work via their free API. Add EVENTBRITE_TOKEN as a repo secret and organizer IDs here — see README.

sources.name: LinkedIn & Facebook events (manual submissions)
sources.note: LinkedIn and Facebook publish no feeds. Chapter leads add validated in-person events to data/manual-events.json via pull request; each entry must link to a live listing on a trusted site.
